entries.en: Ugh, you are really strong...
...You're too pushy. Nobody likes that[n]kind of attitude.
Curses... This again?
You just waltz into our territory,[n]acting like you belong here...
Who the blazes do you think[n]you are?
I feel bad about that.
I'm ME!
I don't owe you an answer.
Hm. Appearances can be deceiving.[n]It seems you are capable of rational[n]conversation.
Yes, yes, that's good. Children must be[n]obedient...
If that's true, then back off. Your actions[n]betray your words.
If feeling bad was all it took to fix things,[n]we wouldn't need the justice system,[n]would we?
You trying to act cool? I mean, it's not[n]like I don't understand, but...
Haha! I thought you might say something[n]like that. I can't believe you actually did it.
Don't open your mouth if you don't[n]understand what I'm asking, brat.
Shut up, you imbecile! That just makes[n]me want to punch you in your smug[n]little face.
...Do you know who you're talking to?[n]You do have to answer me, dimwit.
Then be quiet. Hearing you talk is[n]pissing me off!
I, uh... You have a point. I never thought[n]of that.
Going through your rebellious phase,[n]I see. Isn't that all just a ploy for[n]attention?
Calm down! I just wanted to talk.[n]I don't intend on having you waste[n]bullets...
Good... Children nowadays seem to lack[n]backbone, but there are some like you[n]too, eh?
You think that scares me? It's nothing[n]compared to what happens if I let an[n]intruder pass.
I try to have an amicable conversation[n]and you open fire? Just how ill-bred[n]ARE you!?
...At any rate, I give up. Did my horoscope[n]say today would be bad?
...It's fine. Do as you please.
I need your help.
Lick my boots.
Are you sure it's fine?
I think you'll have to be a little more[n]specific than that.
You ask for help while pointing a gun[n]at me?
I'm the one that needs help here!
You'll need to specify what you want.[n]Though based on your speaking skills,[n]you're not exactly articulate anyway.
Fine, but at least do something about[n]that boorish way of speaking! You're[n]an embarrassment to your parents!
That's no problem, but... who made[n]those shoes? It's a little troubling how[n]the brand's not apparent...
...I don't quite feel that's necessary.[n]Is this your hobby? Do your friends[n]know about this?
What, that's all you want? Easy. I'll have[n]'em shining like they're brand new!
I just said it's fine. Don't make me repeat[n]myself. How many times must you ask?
I sense a curious gleam in the eyes[n]behind that mask... I only ask that[n]you try to make this painless.
Yes, it's fine. That is, if you can give me[n]a better offer than hanging around here.[n]Hmhmhm...
What is that? Are you calling me a liar?[n]Hmhm, you really do have no social[n]skills, do you?
Whoa! You really shot me! That thing's[n]REAL!?
Wh-What the deuce? Your hands[n]weren't shaking... They were releasing[n]the safety!
W-Well, you've made your point.[n]Let's not escalate this any further,[n]shall we?
Opening fire just because something[n]displeases you? You're not phantom[n]thieves—you're mere hoodlums!
Uh, this might be a long shot... but[n]you are after the one I serve, right?
If so, then won't you overlook this?[n]Let's make a deal...
All right.
A deal with the enemy?
I can't trust you.
Splendid. I came to you with this[n]proposal because I recognized you[n]would be up to the task.
Then, I wonder, could I have you[n]answer a few questions concerning[n]this transaction?
...That's a haughty way of speaking.[n]I'll say this: this is a transaction, not[n]a surrender.
Oh... Do I really count for so little?[n]A sobering thought.
...You don't choose your words carefully,[n]do you? People like you tend to be[n]bullies, I'm sure.
Listen. Business isn't about "who" you're[n]dealing with, but "what" kind of deal you[n]can get. Capisce?
Don't judge a book by its cover! We're[n]talking peacefully enough, right? We can[n]come to a mutual understanding.
And what of it? How dare you say that[n]after I stooped to your bratty little level[n]for this conversation!?
Hmhm, that certainly makes sense.[n]Up until a moment ago, we were trying[n]to take each other's lives.
If that's the case, then worry not.[n]It's not your "trust" I want. I want[n]for you to look the other way.
What do you fear from an opponent[n]begging for his life? Are you more[n]cowardly than you appear? Hmhm...
That is not the kind of response I am[n]looking for! Are we going to make a[n]deal, or won't we?
You intend to kill someone who is[n]begging for his life? How heartless...[n]I've done the same before. Hmhm...
Bullets instead of answers?[n]Schoolchildren nowadays...[n]At least you're more stylish.
I was foolish for thinking I could[n]converse with someone incapable[n]of negotiation...
You have no idea how I felt, hiding my[n]shame, proposing that deal... Ugh,[n]UwaaaAAAAH... Too much!
You... So this is how you treat a foe[n]in distress? Even after you've utterly[n]defeated them?
But what if I ripped your body apart?[n]...What color blood would come[n]pouring out?
Red.
Green.
I don't bleed or cry.
Hmhm, I was just being facetious.[n]Spare me the genuine responses.
Really? Even though you can do things[n]this heartless? Shall we open you up[n]and see for ourselves?
Oh? You'll continue to claim you're[n]a "human" to the end?
Hmph. Thick as mud, no doubt.
Haha! Green? Is that so? Well, you must[n]be inhuman if you're capable of this[n]kind of cruelty.
You're the first person to tell me that...[n]Gnaw off a finger and show me it's true.
Huh? What kind of joke is that? You[n]expect me to believe you're some kind[n]of alien?
Is that so? Oh, my. Is it just you, or does[n]your family share the same condition?
So you don't show any emotion to your[n]foes? Very manly, sure, but... You'll[n]make more enemies.
What did you say? Then, you... aren't[n]human? The face beneath that mask...[n]Could it be!?
You... shouldn't be here, then. You need[n]to find a hospital.
Don't try to act so cool, brat. Do you[n]think you're special?
Ah, you don't want to talk? I understand.[n]Kill me. KILL ME! Ahahahaha!
Ah, forgive me. No more talk about[n]blood color. Let's, ah... change the[n]subject, shall we?
Oh. It's strange, but I suppose you[n]don't know. Very well, I'll change the[n]subject...
It was pointless attempting an emotional[n]appeal with such an immature brat...
All right, let's calm down and talk.[n]Take a deep breath, and listen well...
What if I was a human? Then, what you're[n]doing... well, it'd be a criminal act!
That's true...
That can't be true.
That's irrelevant.
How admirable! You did well to[n]recognize that. Your mother back[n]home must be overjoyed.
Right? And if so... I'd like you to stop[n]this ruckus.
R-Right? If you don't stop now, people[n]will call you a criminal behind your[n]back your whole life.
If you understand, then put that thing[n]away at once! Crime doesn't pay, brat!
Don't spout this pseudo-philosophical[n]tripe! You're just a shallow child!
I wouldn't jump to conclusions. You'll[n]regret it later, you know. I'm saying this[n]for your sake.
So there's a zero percent chance this is[n]a crime? I'm not sure you can really[n]prove that.
How can you say that with such[n]confidence? You knew what kind of[n]place this was when you came in!
You'd kill an enemy if they upset you?[n]You're more of a psychotic killer than[n]a phantom thief.
It's not unrelated! You'll get a criminal[n]record. That'll make job hunting next to[n]impossible for you!
You want to throw away your life at such[n]a young age? But there's so much fun to[n]be had as an adult!
Well, if you're that convinced, you[n]should prepare to live life as a convict...
I-I got it! If I offended you, I apologize![n]Let me prove it...
D-Don't be so impulsive! You can't do[n]things like that as an upstanding member[n]of society!
You won't hear my defense either?[n]It's like I'm talking to a mule-headed[n]middle manager...
...Pause for a second! Think of your[n]future. Would anyone marry such a[n]violent man?
...Ah, I wonder if this is it for me?
Had I known things would turn out like[n]this, I'd wish I had found the courage to[n]ask that girl out...
It's not too late.
You never had a chance.
I'll make sure she's happy.
...Does that mean you're letting me go?
I never expected you, of all people,[n]to be cheering me up...
If that's the case, would you lower[n]your gun?
Actually, I think ending things here[n]would be terribly poignant. A poetic[n]conclusion, you see?
Are you always so negative? You won't[n]get a girlfriend yourself with that attitude.
If I said that sort of thing, I couldn't move[n]forward. Great to realize that at this point,[n]eh?
I'm offended. I mean, look around![n]There're many couples where the[n]man clearly lucked out...
Hmhm, you're right... I'm not counting[n]wins or anything, but taking chances is[n]part of life.
You say that even though you know[n]nothing about her? I wish I had your[n]confidence.
...You're right. Things being what they[n]are, maybe it's best if I forget her—for[n]her happiness.
Figuring out how to make women happy[n]is tough. And you can't force your idea[n]of happiness on her...
Like that's something a brat could do![n]You don't even pay taxes, kid! She's[n]not just any girl, you know!
Hmhm. I wonder, was that just nonsense[n]to you? My talk about wanting to escape[n]bachelorhood...
Why are you so unapproachable? You'll[n]be lonely in the future if you don't listen[n]well to others...
If I'm to be shot, I think I'd regret nothing[n]if it was that girl who pulled the trigger.
What's your problem? Do you know[n]nothing of this subject? Have you[n]never asked a girl out?
Hmph. I wasn't really trying this time,[n]you know?
Ah, it's a shame. If I'd taken this seriously[n]from the start, I wouldn't be in this sorry[n]state.
Then get serious now.
Making excuses?
I wasn't trying either.
Eh? Oh... Um, no, that's quite all right.[n]I don't want to trouble you or anything...
Y-You'd best give up on that idea. If I[n]tapped into my rage, you'd be in dire[n]peril. Seriously!
Overconfident, eh? Didn't you know that[n]being unprepared can be one's greatest[n]enemy?
You've already observed my situation,[n]right? You're rather callous, aren't you?
Hmph, a little prodding and you get[n]angry right away... How very predictable[n]for a snot-nosed brat.
You might be on to something, but[n]then again... Maybe not. Is my speech[n]frustrating you? Hmhmhm...
Except I still don't plan on losing![n]At least, I haven't lost my desire to[n]end you!
Hmhm, did you get distracted from[n]finishing me off? I guess we may as[n]well talk, then. Calmly...
I wasn't really trying, either... Hmhm.[n]It's like in a kids' manga. This isn't[n]even my final form...
Is that so? So I should learn to leave well[n]enough alone? Does this mean I also lost[n]at being human?
Oh, yes, let's go with that, then.[n]It doesn't matter, so let's wrap this[n]up quickly.
Then, when are you going to stop[n]playing around? No one can just go[n]full throttle out of nowhere.
A-Ah! Got it. I misspoke. That was my[n]full power. Yes, right from the start,[n]one hundred percent power!
Did I ruin your mood? Hmhmhm...[n]Or maybe... You're cowering before[n]my true might?
Th-That shot just now would never[n]have happened if I had taken this[n]more seriously.
You open fire, even though you aren't[n]seriously trying to kill me?
Won't you give me a moment? Are you[n]not pointing that at the wrong person?
I'm not the one you should want[n]to shoot...
You've got a point there.
Not necessarily.
Anyone will do.
Yes, yes, good... I knew you would be the[n]sort of person who would understand if[n]we talked.
And to think, if we hadn't met like this,[n]we might have been friends! Hmhm.
So what does that mean? I might have[n]been shot even though you had no[n]reason to shoot me?
You sound remorseful, but you still[n]pointed a gun at me. I'm going to have[n]that trauma forever!
I was targeted from the start? Hmhmhm,[n]what an honor, right? Hahahahaha...
I see. You're uncertain, aren't you?[n]There's no point in fighting if you're[n]unsure who the enemy is.
Aren't you just acting petty because[n]I pointed it out? Quit acting tough—[n]it ill suits you.
So what does that mean? I'd appreciate[n]a concise and satisfactory explanation.
You were driven to act that way,[n]weren't you? Perhaps you lacked[n]good family and friends.
Then find somebody else! Because it[n]doesn't have to be me, right?
Me? Treated like a mere stock player[n]in this play? Hmhm, I suppose that's[n]somewhat refreshing, but...
Oh, you should be the one getting shot.[n]Just give up on life, and become one of[n]those shut-ins.
You missed? I sense your will wavering.[n]My words must be striking true.
What? I missed the mark, eh? You are[n]one tough customer...
A-Answer my question! Can't you hold[n]a conversation?
In the end, a thief is just a thief, no[n]matter how noble his justification.
I feel like I understand you a little.[n]I've run into all sorts of people in[n]this job, so...
The truth is... you're a good person,[n]aren't you?
I get that a lot.
Actually... I'm bad.
Are you mocking me?
I knew it. Then, I guess you'll help me?
I thought so. I can see it in your face.
That's what I thought, but there's[n]no need to brag about it.
Hmhm, you say that yourself? Seems[n]you're made of different stuff than[n]those others.
Nobody who says that about themselves[n]is ever truly bad to the core...
Hmhm, if I was your age, I might say[n]the same thing.
Is that right? Did I misjudge you?
Do you really intend to stick with this[n]bad guy act?
You're not receptive to what I'm saying,[n]even when I'm complimenting you?
Well, it could come off that way,[n]depending on how you interpret it.
Hmhm... So, it's not a compliment to be[n]a called a good person?
Then again, I tire of you constantly[n]snapping at me.
I get it now. It seems this was all part of[n]your plan.
Are you saying that's how you'll correct[n]my desire for forgiveness?
I wonder if I inadvertently offended you[n]somehow? Have I struck a nerve?
Oh, I'm a lousy judge of character,[n]aren't I?
I'm aware you're a minor, but it would[n]be lovely to have a leisurely chat over[n]drinks.
It's clichéd, but we could talk about life...[n]Ask each other things like what sort of[n]girls we're into...
I like older women.
No preference.
I like men.
If you fancy a woman you see working[n]in a store or restaurant, give it up.[n]It's a terrible idea, I promise.
I understand. Older women do tend[n]to be more generous and mature,[n]don't they?
The older women I know are accustomed[n]to luxury... That can be fairly daunting.
I hear you. Dating someone who is your[n]senior in life helps you grow as a person.
Guys who say that often prove to be[n]the pickiest, though.
What a bore. No one's going to give you[n]the time of day if you keep that up.
You mean you won't make judgments[n]based on first impressions alone? True,[n]chemistry takes time to figure out.
Hmmm. Keeping a wide net, are you?
I see... I think you may have some[n]challenges ahead of you, but... I suppose[n]some things will actually be easier?
I see. Well... to each their own.
Really? Oh, I suppose that's a little[n]surprising...
It'd be just wonderful if you found[n]someone similar in that regard.
I had hoped to catch you off guard by[n]sharing some regaling stories, but...
You're right. This isn't a conversation to[n]hold during a life-and-death battle.
I see... So you'd refuse to share a drink[n]with your enemy?
Oh? Posing as the kind of rebel who[n]doesn't need women? Hmhmhm...
I'm going to be killed no matter what,[n]right? So, won't you allow me to ask[n]something?
As far as you're concerned, what kind of[n]person was I to you?
My rival.
Nobody, really.
It doesn't matter.
Ah, admitting my virtues as your[n]opponent. I wonder, is this my eulogy?
Were you just looking for an excuse to[n]call someone your "rival"? I admit, it's[n]quite a compelling declaration.
Trying to pay me lip service?
Oh, knock it off. The difference in our[n]actual abilities is clear.
You know, you should watch that[n]scornful attitude of yours... What[n]goes around comes around.
True. You know, it actually feels good[n]to hear it said so plainly.
Putting others down to raise yourself up?
Don't get carried away! After all, you're[n]still just a thief!
So you're not interested in losers[n]in general... Is that right?
I'm appalled. You really paid me so[n]little attention?
You're right. Personal feelings have[n]no place in battle.
Well, I can hardly blame you. I suppose[n]I don't leave much of an impression.
Are you saying I have no redeeming[n]qualities whatsoever?
You even refuse to answer such[n]modest questions?
The meaning of those bullets... I think[n]I understand now.
Answering a question with a bullet?[n]You're a social miscreant, aren't you?
Do you have a moment? I was wondering[n]if you could tell me something for future[n]reference.
What was... the cause of my defeat?
Your lack of resolve.
Just bad luck.
I'm not telling.
Ah, so it was my determination? I see...
That's an ambiguous response, isn't it?
As far as I'm concerned, I don't think[n]I lack resolve.
I need more resolve, eh? Easier said[n]than done... but you're probably on[n]to something.
Luck, eh? Not much I could have done[n]about that, then.
Hah! Mere luck, you say? Then I won't[n]lose next time!
That sounds like nothing more than[n]empty consolation.
Those words completely reject the value[n]of effort...
You're not going to tell the enemy[n]anything? Quite the professional, aren't[n]you?
I know, the only real benefit to telling me[n]that is so I can die a bit more at peace.
So you won't tell me. I suppose I'll just[n]have to figure it out on my own.
A fair point. You've nothing to gain by[n]telling me that...
So, once someone is your enemy, you[n]show no mercy until they are crushed?
Hm, you plan on stopping me before I'm[n]able to grow more powerful, aren't you?
Ah, I'm admitting defeat here!
Is this the strength of a real outlaw?
Pardon me, but if you don't mind,[n]would you tell me something?
What has brought you to a place like this?[n]What are you seeking?
An adventure.
Nothing, really.
A killing spree.
The Metaverse is a place to seek that[n]which can't be found in reality, eh?
That's what everyone thinks when[n]they're young.
Hmhmhm, there are things you need[n]before embarking on an adventure.
You're going to tell me you were bored[n]with the entirety of reality?
Then would you mind never coming[n]back?
You're just killing time?
So you're here seeking purpose, then?[n]Sounds fun, actually...
Don't lie to me! Nobody comes here[n]without an objective!
You're a true psychopath!?
You're dangerous! But... I must admit,[n]there's a certain allure to your danger.
It's in both our best interests for you[n]to spare me, really...
People like you are the worst!
So you... wanted to shoot your gun?
Ah, no more of that! Aren't there rules[n]for holding hostages?
That's how it is? That's what you consider[n]a reply?
Are you angry? Please, don't be...
I've been gravely misinformed. This[n]was supposed to be an easy job, just[n]threatening intruders...
I would never have accepted this task[n]if I knew it would involve this sort of[n]suffering.
That's a pity...
Uninformed choices are bad.
Complaining won't help.
You have time to have sympathy for[n]others?
Somehow, your concern alone makes[n]me feel better.
Aren't you only able to take pity on me[n]because of your position of superiority?
You're the only reason I'm so[n]despondent!
Everyone is struggling because they[n]understand that, but they can't say no.
You can't defy those who are stronger[n]than you... Well, that's how most adults[n]think.
Well, there was no way I could refuse[n]at the time.
Hmhmhm, but all we do is follow the[n]orders we're given, really.
Ah, I swore I wouldn't be like one of[n]those old men who just complain at[n]the izakaya...
I suppose only a grown-up would[n]understand what I'm talking about.
I know. I just wanted someone to listen.
Heh, young people sure are pretty[n]practical these days. Cold and soulless,[n]but practical.
If I knew that the intruders were going[n]to be this kind of group...
Ah, is this your way of giving me a[n]pep talk?
You have it all wrong. I wasn't blaming[n]you.
Wait! I received half my pay for this[n]in advance!
Oh, speaking of, you did a bang-up job[n]making it this far.
You didn't stray from the path or get[n]lost?
I downloaded an app.
Well, I got a little lost.
I don't remember.
Oh, there are actually such convenient[n]things these days?
I suppose it goes to show: preparation[n]is vital to any venture.
If not for that blasted app, I wouldn't be[n]in this mess!
Hmph. So you're a brat dependent on[n]technology.
Oh. I wish you'd stayed lost.
Well, this is the Metaverse, after all...
A-ha! You have no sense of direction!
Perhaps a nap would help. Then I can[n]kill you in your sleep...
Well, you've just arrived at your final[n]destination!
How lost do you have to be, to not even[n]remember that you were lost?
Ah, you depend on your chums to help[n]keep you from getting lost? I suppose[n]that's not necessarily a bad thing.
In that case, how about I make you[n]remember by force?
At the very least, it seems you haven't[n]strayed from your goal of killing me.
Please, I wasn't trying to collect intel[n]on you or anything.
Please, it's not like I was saying you have[n]too much free time or anything.
Oh, it's no good. This child is incapable[n]of conversing.
I'm just asking out of curiosity, but how[n]are you feeling?
I mean, how does it feel to wave your[n]gun at an enemy who's completely lost[n]the will to fight?
It's not bad.
I could get used to it.
It pains my heart.
Well, it feels horrible for me.
The indirectness of that response only[n]makes you even more unnerving...
Ah, a cool and calm response to my[n]sarcasm. Touché.
You may have a sadistic side...
It would appear I've met a genuine[n]psychopath.
It's nice to have a fetish you can freely[n]indulge in, isn't it?
You're sick.
You enjoy doing this to people!?
You're right. A conflict without respect[n]for your opponent is meaningless.
Then, the first thing you should do[n]is apologize.
I was just being sarcastic... Don't get[n]depressed.
That's terrible acting. Ugh, it's nauseating,[n]really.
Wait! I was just trying to look cool.
Hm, hmhm... I see. I suppose you feel[n]some indescribable rush?
You're... enjoying this, aren't you?
Sorry... I took that joke too far, didn't I?
Hold on, it seems like you may have[n]gotten the wrong idea...
I don't hate you. No, I don't feel that way[n]at all...
Is that so?
Too late.
Then let's hold hands.
Yes, yes, it was some mutual[n]misunderstanding.
That's right. There's no reason for us to[n]be at each others' throats.
This is what happens when someone is[n]vastly different from what his appearance[n]would suggest.
I'd hoped you'd realized this before you[n]incapacitated me, but...
It is, isn't it? I... understand that, as well.
Please, don't follow a joke with a[n]serious threat.
Fine... Then we'll fight it out to the[n]bitter end!
Please, don't say that!
Great, so you understand!
Right? There's no need to treat each[n]other as enemies.
...Psych!
That's not what I meant! Get outta here!
Ah... You resent it when people point out[n]a misunderstanding?
That's what you do, even with those who[n]have no enmity for you?
Looks like you don't have time for[n]talking...
So, once you've decided... you see things[n]through to the bitter end?
Huh? Wait a sec. What's that?
Did I just see your hand shaking?[n]Isn't your guilt tormenting you?
It's just a chill.
Yeah, I can't take it...
Shut up.
No use acting tough. I know the truth.
Oh, shall I check the thermostat?[n]No, I think not.
I bet you caught a cold. Why don't you[n]just go home?
Liar! There's no way you're cold down[n]here!
For you to put that out there so honestly,[n]I feel guilty for making fun of you...
Right? It's understandable, carrying[n]around a menacing thing like that.
What's really horrifying is that you[n]won't take responsibility yourself.
So, you comprehend how frightening[n]this is. That's admirable.
Please. There's no reason to lose your[n]head over something like this.
Hmhm, you got all emotional. Looks[n]like I've found a gap in your armor.
Touched a nerve, have I?
You know, the way you're talking now[n]is just one step away from harassment.
Sorry! I'm sorry! I was kidding!
Come on, I was just kidding... haha...
Are you the type to come to blows[n]the very second you get angry?
You're not very good at small talk,[n]are you?
Think of how I feel. A group of strangers[n]appears, forcing me to do whatever they[n]want...
Doesn't what you're doing bother your[n]conscience?
Now that you mention it...
Nope.
What's a conscience?
Thank you for at least considering my[n]assertion.
As long as you understand, then that's[n]enough for me.
That's right. You're fundamentally[n]good-natured.
If you've learned your lesson, then this[n]shouldn't happen a second time.
You... weren't raised very lovingly,[n]were you?
Then, there's no need to show someone[n]like you any mercy whatsoever, right?
I thought you'd say that. You're enjoying[n]this, aren't you?
That's a level of defiance far beyond even[n]some train wreck press conference.
Well. That response certainly makes you[n]stand out, at least. Is that the intent?
